import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        int best_x = 0;
        int best_y = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long temp = (x * i) / y;
            long diff1 = x * i - temp * y;
            long diff2 = (temp + 1) * y - x * i;
            if (diff1 > diff2) {
                temp++;
            }
            if (Math.abs(best_y * (x * i - temp * y)) < Math.abs(i * (x * best_y - y * best_x))) {
                best_x = (int) temp;
                best_y = i;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best_x + "/" + best_y);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
